Overview.Name: Suuda Gangi Reddy
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results

Meal_1: Option 1: 3 whole eggs omelette pan fried & salad
Option 2: Chicken pieces (small bowl) & RICE RAWA upma (small)
Option 3: Puffed rice (2 cups) & 2 boiled eggs (lighter option)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & grilled chicken (palm size) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & grilled fish (pan fried) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & mutton curry (moderate portion) (lighter option)
Meal_3: Option 1: Chicken stir fry (light portion) & salad
Option 3: Grilled fish (small portion) & sautéed vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Your goal is physique improvement, so keep protein portions slightly higher at each meal.
Because boredom triggers overeating, avoid keeping sweets at home and choose makhana or eggs when hungry.
For sweet cravings, eat fruit after lunch instead of late night snacks.
Short sleep can increase hunger, so try to keep dinner light and avoid heavy late meals.
Simple pan fried or grilled cooking will help you stay consistent.
